description: This file defines the RetrieveFeatureStrategy class, a final class implementing command handling logic for retrieving features from a Thing object within a persistence layer, including methods for extracting feature details and managing entity tags.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureStrategy
classes.description: Implements a command strategy for retrieving features from a Thing, handling feature extraction, JSON serialization, and entity tag management.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the retrieval command, extracting features from the Thing and returning the appropriate result.

methods.name: extractFeatures
methods.description: Extracts Features from the given Thing, throwing an exception if not present.

methods.name: getFeatureResult
methods.description: Constructs the result for the feature retrieval, including handling not found cases.

methods.name: getFeatureJson
methods.description: Serializes the feature to JSON, selecting specific fields if requested.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag based on the current state of the feature within the Thing.
